setup: The function is \(f(z) = [[fz]]\), with a simple pole at \(z = [[z0]]\).

steps.say: At a simple pole the residue is the limit of \((z - z_0)f(z)\) as \(z \to z_0\).
The numerator is \([[a]]z [[constant]]\), and multiplying by \(z - [[z0]]\) leaves exactly that.
Evaluating at \(z = [[z0]]\) gives real part [[real]] and imaginary part [[imag]].
